notes.title: Performance Update
notes.notes:
Updated corescript and plugins to improve performance and reduce occurrences of bugs.

If any bugs are found, please report them in the Vane discussion thread so that they may be squashed.

Thank you, awesome players!

notes.title: Jewels and Appearance Update
notes.notes:
Save Menu UI Updated.

Added the Jewelcrafter.
-Combine Gems to make a Jewel which grants permanent abilities and attribute bonus.
-The Jewelcrafter may be found in every town.

Added more appearance options and the option to change mid-game.
-8 more options to chose from.

Added new discoverable locations to the world map.

Fixed a bug preventing the player from leaving King Ferim's Chambers.
